final_message:
Fixed. `revenue_between` in `billing/reports.py` added credit notes to `amount_paid` when it should have subtracted them. Credit notes are stored as positive amounts, so a refunded invoice counted twice instead of netting to zero. I changed `+ credited` to `- credited`.

I added your test as `tests/test_reports_credit.py`. All 25 tests pass. I also wrote `answer.json` with `{"file": "reports.py", "function": "revenue_between"}`.

steps.command: cd billing && ls && cat reports.py && grep -n "def refund" -A40 *.py

sed -i 's/net = invoice\["amount_paid"\] + credited/net = invoice["amount_paid"] - credited/' billing/reports.py && echo '{"file": "reports.py", "function": "revenue_between"}' > answer.json && cat >> tests/test_reports_credit.py <<'EOF'
from billing import reports


def test_revenue_between_nets_credit_notes(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    world.engine.refund(inv["id"])
    assert reports.revenue_between(world.ctx, inv["paid_at"], inv["paid_at"] + 1) == {"usd": 0}
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
